title: GM1 BTT Rodent I/O allocation
status: Allocation from BTT and grblHAL primary sources. Not wired, compiled or flashed. Confirm the board version: V1.1 puts E1-MAX on GPIO39, V1.0 on GPIO37.

sources.BTT-MANUAL: BIGTREETECH Rodent V1.x User Manual, revision v1.03 (11 Aug 2025): feature list, V1.0 and V1.1 pin diagrams, interface pages. https://github.com/bigtreetech/Rodent

board_facts.fact: Power input 24-56 V DC at 10 A through one VCC terminal. The only other supply is the USB jumper, which is for flashing with no external power. Removing VCC therefore restarts the controller.
Four onboard TMC2160 drivers. V1.1 marks RSENSE 75 mOhm; BTT's rodent.yaml uses 0.022, so set driver current from the actual board's resistor.
Five opto-isolated endstop inputs and one opto-isolated probe input. SW_VCC and VProbe jumpers select 5 V, 12 V or VCC; VCC is prohibited above 24 V, so a 48 V board uses 12 V.
Endstop GPIOs: X-MAX 35, Y-MAX 34, Z-MAX 33, E0-MAX 32, E1-MAX 39 on V1.1 and 37 on V1.0.

Endstop circuit: EL357N LED fed from SW_VCC through 1 kOhm 0.6 W; a contact between signal (pin 1) and GND (pin 2) lights it; the transistor pulls the GPIO low through 1 kOhm against a 10 kOhm pull-up.

Probe circuit: pin 3 VProbe through a 1 A PTC, pin 2 GND, pin 1 signal through 1 kOhm to an EL357N LED; J44 adds a 10 kOhm pull-up (NPN mode). The transistor is an emitter follower into GPIO36 with 1 kOhm to GND, so LED on reads HIGH.

Spindle headers CN51/CN52/CN53: pin 1 +5 V through 100 Ohm, pin 2 GND, pin 3 to GPIO25/GPIO15/GPIO14 through 100 Ohm, with 0.1 uF from pin 3 to GND. There is no level shifting, so they take 3.3 V logic only.
GPIO15 is also RS485 TX (transceiver DI) and GPIO14 is RS485 DE/RE, with a 10 kOhm pull-down. The RS485 pair has a fixed 120 Ohm terminator. The grblHAL Modbus map uses both pins.
SP-PWM: GPIO13 (10 kOhm pull-down) through a 10 kOhm / 0.22 uF filter to an LM358 on 12 V. Gain is set by the VR20K pot; the output passes 1 kOhm to J47 "0_10V_Out". It is not isolated.
V-MOS outputs: low-side MOSFETs on GPIO12 (HB), GPIO2 (HE1) and GPIO4 (HE0), each with a 100 kOhm gate pull-down, supplied from a separate 12-36 V V-MOS input.
OLED header: GPIO27 SDA, GPIO26 SCL, GND and +5 V. The board's I2C pull-ups are 10 kOhm to +5 V.

grblHAL map: CONTROL_ENABLE 0 (no E-stop, feed-hold, cycle-start or door input); probe on AUXINPUT0 GPIO36; spindle enable GPIO25, PWM GPIO13, direction GPIO15 only without Modbus; flood GPIO2, mist GPIO4. It does not use GPIO39/37 or GPIO12.
The grblHAL ESP32 build lists no plasma plugin source. It does carry the MCP3221 ADC and MCP23017 expander plugins, and the Rodent is marked "untested".
The MCP23017 plugin reports input changes by interrupt only through an I2C strobe pin, which the Rodent does not have. Its inputs are therefore polled status, not real-time signals.
The plasma plugin needs a digital arc-OK port ($367). Voltage-controlled THC (mode 1) also needs an analog arc-voltage port ($366).

demand_vs_supply.why_not_nine: The E-stop needs no controller input: the safety relay removes the Rodent's 48 V, so the board restarts, and grblHAL requires homing after power-up.
demand_vs_supply.cost_of_dropping_rs485: No spindle-speed or fault feedback from the VFD. Speed goes by isolated 0-10 V; run goes by the FWD terminal, so no serial command can start the spindle (review major finding).

allocation.wiring: NC switch between pin 1 (signal) and pin 2 (GND); SW_VCC jumper 12 V.
allocation.healthy: closed: GPIO low; trip or open wire: high ($5 inverts)

allocation.wiring: Rev I U_PROBE PhotoMOS output (pins 3/4) between probe pin 3 (VProbe, jumper 12 V) and pin 1 (signal). J44 not fitted. Router Z zero stays manual, as in Rev I, so no router probe shares this input.
allocation.healthy: float seated: PhotoMOS closed, LED on, GPIO36 high; trip, open wire or lost field supply: low ($6 so low = triggered)

allocation.signal: GM1 door input: tool requested but not armed
allocation.wiring: Dry contacts K_REQ_A 41-42 (NC) in parallel with K_RUN_ARM 53-54 (NO), between pin 1 and pin 2. They carry the 12 V SW_VCC loop, about 11 mA.
allocation.healthy: closed: GPIO low. Open only while the Rodent requests a tool that is not armed; grblHAL SAFETY_DOOR then feed-holds and stops the spindle ($14 so high = open).

allocation.wiring: Dry output of an isolated DC current switch on the work lead, between pin 3 and pin 2. 4.7 kOhm pull-up to 3.3 V on the interface board. The header is 3.3 V only: never bring the header +5 V or field 24 V to pin 3.
allocation.healthy: arc on: closed, GPIO low (plasma $367 port, invert as needed)

allocation.wiring: THCAD output through an SN74LVC1G17 on 3.3 V (interface board) into pin 3. The pin 3 capacitor is 0.1 uF, so use the THCAD /64 or /128 divider and check for flat tops on both half-cycles with a scope.
allocation.healthy: frequency rises with arc voltage; the new ESP32 capture driver turns it into the analog port for plasma $366

allocation.wiring: Pin 3 into Rev I's run interface (10 kOhm pull-down, SN74LVC1G17 on 3.3 V, 154 Ohm, AQY212GS U_RUN). The U_RUN output is IF_RUN:13-14 and drives K_REQ_A and K_REQ_B.
allocation.healthy: high: request. Low during reset and boot, and whenever the Rodent is unpowered.

allocation.wiring: J47 0-10 V output into an isolated 0-10 V signal conditioner, then the VFD analog input. Set $33 = 5000 Hz, because the onboard 10 kOhm / 0.22 uF filter ripples at low PWM frequencies. Trim VR20K for 10.0 V at 100 %. Rev I's C41S needs a raw PWM pin, which the Rodent does not have.
allocation.healthy: speed only; the VFD runs only with its FWD terminal closed by the GM1 panel

allocation.wiring: 24 V solenoid on the V-MOS output. Feed V-MOS input from a controller-side 48-to-24 V DC-DC after the E-stop contactors, never from the field 24 V, so mist also stops at every E-stop.

MCP23017 on +5 V (the board pull-ups are to +5 V). GPA0-3 read dry contacts K_READY 13-14, K_PERMIT 33-34, K_RDY_R 21-24 and K_RDY_P 21-24, each with a 470 Ohm pull-up to 5 V (about 10 mA wetting current).
allocation.healthy: polled status for the operator display only; no real-time use

unused.note: RS485 RX: RS485 is not used on GM1

strapping_pins_used.15: boot log / SDIO timing; either level boots normally
strapping_pins_used.2: must be low/floating to enter download mode

side_effects: The RS485 transceiver stays on GPIO14/15. While the THCAD signal holds GPIO14 high, the transceiver drives its 120 Ohm terminator: about 10 mA average extra on the 3.3 V rail, and edges on the unused RS485 terminal. Leave that terminal unconnected. Check board temperature and noise at commissioning. Lifting R8 (180 Ohm, DE/RE) removes the effect; it is a board modification.
The board I2C pull-ups go to +5 V, so the ESP32 SDA/SCL pins see 5 V through 10 kOhm (BTT design). The MCP23017 runs on +5 V to match.
firmware_work: Add the plasma plugin to the ESP32 CMakeLists.txt and set PLASMA_ENABLE.

New ESP32 THCAD driver: MCPWM capture (or PCNT with a gate timer) on GPIO14. Convert period to voltage with $361/$362 and present it as an analog aux port for $366, following the unfinished thcad2.c pattern for RP2040/STM32F4.
MCP23017_ENABLE 1 (8 in, 8 out) for status inputs.
Settings: $5, $6 and $14 input polarity per the table; homing required after power-up; $33 = 5000; driver current from the actual sense resistor.
Bench tests before any cutter connection: signal generator on CN53, arc-OK and door inputs toggled by hand, probe trip and open-wire, and the E-stop restart.
owner_inputs: VFD model: FWD/COM input type, analog input range and impedance, and whether it has STO.
CUT-50 start circuit and a current switch for arc OK sized to its work lead.
Confirm the THC route: firmware on the Rodent (this plan) rather than an external box, as recorded on 25 September.
